acceptance_rules: There is exactly one active mathematical plan with one target collection and one roadmap identity.
The old-to-new address map is a bijection on all 77 targets; all 321 internal edges and each external contract are preserved.
General parts N, M, A and C have no P or G target in their transitive prerequisite closure.
Part G has no P target in its transitive prerequisite closure.
Part P intrinsic layers P1–P8 do not depend on the scalar-comparison layer P9.
Native mathematical carriers and general proofs are shared; applications verify their own admission and comparison hypotheses.
The complete English and Japanese bodies, including scope, examples, appendices and sources, are retained modulo explicit address and document-location normalization.
status_boundary: The parts are sections of one roadmap, not six separately owned active roadmaps. Proposed future upstream destinations remain proposals.
